- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.33) in recent days, model tends to underpredict upward moves; adjust forecast upward by 0.5–1.5% of recent range.
- When sentiment is negative (≤ 0.00), model often overpredicts downward moves; adjust downward by 0.5–1.5% of recent range.
- Model consistently overestimates short-term spikes (e.g., +2–3% above true peak) — cap forecast at 1.5–2% below true peak after spike.
- Model underestimates mean reversion in 30-day horizon — if recent 7-day average is > 1.5% above 30d mean, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0%.
- If sentiment history shows 3+ consecutive 0.00 values, model tends to lag by 1–2 days; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead by +0.5–1.0%.
- For 30d forecasts, if true outcome exceeds model by > 2.0% in 3 consecutive days, apply “overshoot correction” — reduce next forecast by 0.5–1.0% per day until convergence.
